correctness.rationale: Original 2022 paper defines Z_i0^(n) by summing over spin configurations with root fixed, and at J=J_p=h=0 Hamiltonian identically vanishes. Tree order 2 has |V_n|=2^(n+1)-1 so exact Z_fixed=2^(2^(n+1)-2). Original Theorem 1 (11) at theta=phi=u=1 has two local brackets each 8²=64 giving 128^(2^(n-1)-1): n=2 gives 128 instead of exact 64; n=3 gives 2^21 > total unrestricted 2^15. Original Theorem 2 limit gives 7 ln 2/(4beta), whereas direct count gives ln2/beta. All primary displayed formulas were inspected on PDF page screenshots, and independently recomputed exact integer comparisons. This is printed formula contradiction only, not claim about separately executed simulations.
